research_mechanism: The1761 broad signed arithmetic route lowers two compound-data variable signed shifts while both measured targets exceed the earlier1729 guarded point, increasing underprediction and absolute error.
signed_add_boolean_mechanism: Low-mask upward changes help; high-mask changes overshoot actual targets. Restoring every row to base would satisfy MAE but worsen subgroup MAPE versus current, so a blanket abstention cannot meet the preregistered joint gate.
feasibility: Research can improve bothMAE/MAPE by recovering the earlier compound-data points; signed-add subgroup can jointly improve by keeping lowmask improvements and correcting highmask overshoot. These are diagnostic consumed-label observations, not an inference lookup policy.
